title: AI platform for gastric biopsy triage evaluated prospectively across NHS Wales
summary: In 848 consecutive gastric biopsy cases across three NHS Health Boards, a commercial AI platform reached sensitivity 100% (95% CI 91.2-100) and specificity 97.2% for gastric malignancy (n=40; AUC 0.986). It captured eight primary lesions missed in routine review and, in simulated prioritisation, ranked all cancers as urgent with 4.6% false-positive alerts. The malignancy count is small and the algorithm is not described.
ai_technology: Commercial AI platform for gastric biopsy triage and diagnostic support

evidence.tested: Prospective multi-centre cohort compared with standard-of-care reference diagnoses.
evidence.unknown: The algorithm and long-term clinical effect are not described; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Flagged and prioritized gastric biopsy findings.
